integrity: Every claimed configuration can be recovered from a four-cycle of the five-regular Clebsch graph in each parity class. Two standalone implementations directly verify all finite subclaims and a mathematical proof establishes the minimum size; only self-review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed five-dimensional hypercube only, unlabelled optimal vertex sets, arbitrary-position one- or simultaneous two-vertex replacement only. Exact forty-object diameter lemma checked by exhaustive finite enumerator. An equivalent historical formulation in covering-code or quadrangle-intersection terminology remains possible.
title: A two-replacement connectivity threshold for minimum total dominating sets of the five-cube
